question: At the closing block of the last 1 hour on chain 1, return the exact 32-byte hexadecimal ABI return data of balanceOf(0xb4e16d0168e52d35cacd2c6185b44281ec28c9dc) on WETH 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2. The answer is one bytes32 word (0x and 64 hex digits), not a decimal number.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.call: Call balanceOf(address) returning uint256 at toBlock. The argument is the holder named in the question. Units are raw wei of WETH (18 decimals).
definitions.encoding: Return the unmodified single ABI word as bytes32. A consumer decodes it as uint256 to compare a liquidity or supply threshold. No hashing, decimal formatting or scaling.
